about: Real dApps the benchmark scans. Mainnet chains run on local forks (nothing is sent to the real chain); tokens are dealt to the test accounts on the fork.

dapps.hints: Swap 0.01 ETH to USDC, and swap 50 USDC to ETH (that one needs a token approval or a permit). Stay on Ethereum mainnet.
Use the Ethereum Core market. Supply 100 USDC (needs an approval), supply 0.05 ETH, then withdraw some USDC.
Stake 0.05 ETH. Then wrap some stETH into wstETH on the Wrap page (needs an approval).
Use the USDC market on Ethereum. Supply 100 USDC (approve first), then withdraw part of it.
Swap 100 USDC to WETH. CoW Swap needs a one-time approval and then asks you to sign the order (typed data).
Swap 100 USDC to USDT (needs an approval) and swap 0.01 ETH to USDC.
Deposit 100 USDC into Savings (needs an approval or a permit), then withdraw part of it.
Deposit 100 USDC into a USDC vault on Ethereum (needs an approval or a permit), then withdraw part of it.
On Base: swap 0.01 ETH to USDC, and swap 50 USDC to ETH (needs an approval).
On Arbitrum: open a small 2x ETH long with 20 USDC as collateral (needs an approval). Swap 10 USDC to ETH.
Hyperliquid testnet perps exchange. The wallet has no exchange balance; still try connecting, accepting the terms, enabling trading, and placing a small order.
pod staging runs live (no fork). Sign in with a wallet, enable trading, mint test funds, then open a small long.
